name: What specific measurements do I need to provide for appliance area preparation?

mainEntity.name: What specific measurements do I need to provide for appliance area preparation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accurate measurements are essential for successful appliance-area preparation. You will need to provide the precise dimensions of the appliance (width, height, depth, including door swing and clearance requirements), as well as the available space for installation. This includes clearances for ventilation, access for maintenance, and the location of existing or planned utility hook-ups. Frasheski Construction's team can assist with verifying these measurements to ensure a perfect fit, especially for custom cabinetry or built-in units common in El Cerrito and surrounding areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide precise appliance dimensions, including clearances for ventilation and access, along with the available installation space to ensure a proper fit.
